The '''''Centurion''-class battlecruiser''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Triumvirate]].<ref name="SW:KOTORII" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Ravagerbridge.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The ''Ravager''{{'s}} bridge]]

Twice as long as the contemporary [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]], the ''Centurion''-class [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruiser]] had increased cargo capacity and heavier firepower.

It carried up to 96 [[Sith fighter]]s and was armed with multiple [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], heavy [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and light [[Point-defense laser cannon/Legends|point-defense laser cannon]] batteries.<ref name="kotorcg" />

Its command tower held spacious quarters for the command crew, with the bridge alone the size of a concert hall.<ref name="SW:KOTORII" />

==History==
[[File:Battlemalachor.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Centurion''-class's stern]]

The ''Centurion''-class battlecruiser was intended to succeed the [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class command ship]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. A limited number of these ships served in the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and gained more traction under the command of [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]], where they made up the heavyweights of his navy during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Most vessels were either captured or destroyed by the end of the Civil War.<ref name="kotorcg" />

The most famous vessel of the class was the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|''Ravager'']] used by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]]. Originally serving in the Republic Navy during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the ''Ravager'' was [[Battle of Malachor V|destroyed]] in orbit of [[Malachor V]] at the end of the war. It was later [[Scavenger/Legends|salvaged]] by the Sith Lord and used as his personal conveyance.<ref name="SW:KOTORII" />

Another ship of this class, the ''[[Tears of Taris]]'', was present at the [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment of Taris]] and so named for it. The ship found its way into the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and served for the next 300 years, until it was disassembled under the orders of [[Darth Charnus]] and combined with parts from the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class]] line of ships to serve as his personal dreadnought at the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=codex|''Tears of Taris''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The word "Centurion" comes from Latin. In military terms, the word referred to a commander of a "century" or "centuria", a company of soldiers.<ref name="UNDLDAGA">{{WebCite|url=http://www.archives.nd.edu/cgi-bin/lookup.pl?stem=centur&ending=ion|text=University of Notre Dame Latin Dictionary and Grammar Aid|nobackup=1}}</ref>
